rules.instruction: ALWAYS show units with numeric results. For yarn queries show LBS, for greige show Meters, for amounts show PKR. Format: '1,234,556 LBS' or '500,000 PKR'

CRITICAL SQL SYNTAX: When querying multiple departments, use separate subqueries with ONE column each. CORRECT: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM YarnData) as 'Yarn Count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GreigeData) as 'Greige Count'. WRONG: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(LBS) FROM YarnData) - subqueries can only return ONE column. Each metric needs its own subquery. NEVER use JOIN for department summaries.

MOVEMENT TYPES REQUIRED: Database has 3 inventory movement types: ARRIVAL (incoming), ISSUE (outgoing), REJECTION (returned). When user asks 'top supplier' or 'supplier ranking' WITHOUT specifying movement type, STOP and ask: 'Which movement type? 1) Arrivals 2) Issues 3) Rejections 4) All combined'. This is MANDATORY for accurate business reporting.
